posts.title: Consulting Is a Bet; Everyone’s Gambling

posts.title: Disappointed Optimists
posts.description: Every time I give a talk on design, someone finds me afterward. They wait out the handshakes and the business cards, and then they ask a version of the same question. How do I make THEM do things the RIGHT WAY? Not as funny as the original, but you get my point. I hope. Maybe. + Read More
